name: Numes
description: An inference marketplace with separate zero-priced free model routes.
overview: Numes documents :free routes that only use zero-priced endpoints and never fall back to paid ones. Free requests require verified email and have separate rate limits, but their numerical limits and card requirements were not established. Zero-balance traffic has lower priority under load; supply and model availability change; no authenticated inference, billing or model identity was independently tested.
free_access: Free routes never fall back to paid endpoints
Verified email required; rate limits apply
Numeric limit and card requirement unconfirmed
Live free model supply may change
notes: Base URL https://api.numes.ai/api/v1. Select exact :free IDs and check the live catalog.
